plugins.description: Build Vue and Nuxt apps with the maz-ui ecosystem instead of re-implementing it: the maz-ui rules in every session and subagent, maz-ui skill, UI subagent and upgrade skill, MCP server (project setup, docs, component APIs, icons, Tailwind theme tokens, code review) and hooks that review every edited file and, at the end of a task, the files changed in git
